Chapter 348 - 348 Success; Cooperation Plan! (1)

348 Success; Cooperation Plan! (1)

This ‘thank you’ was for Lin Fan giving up his interests for the sake of the country.

At the same time, he was also thanking Lin Fan on behalf of the millions of people with diabetes in Hua Nation.

Feng Yuxiang did not stay at Jiangbei University for long. He took the human islet recovery medicine and took the fastest flight to Jingbei.

After arriving in Jingbei, he rushed to the Academy of Sciences.

Along the way, some experts and academicians greeted him.

In the past, Feng Yuxiang would return their greetings one by one.

However, today, it was as if he did not hear them. He simply walked over with large strides.

When he arrived at the Medical Research Institute, Feng Yuxiang called out, “Academician Wang, Academician Li, I just got this from Lin Fan. Quickly test it and see if it has any effect on diabetes.”

Academician Wang’s expression changed. He said in disbelief, “Director Feng, you mean Lin Fan… has already developed it?”

“Yes!” Feng Yuxiang nodded vigorously.

“Quick, let me see!” Academician Li said.

Then, Academician Wang and Academician Li held the bottle of transparent solution and carefully studied it.

Five hours passed.

“Rat A’s blood sugar and hormone levels have stabilized!”

“Rat B’s blood sugar and hormone levels have stabilized!”

“Rat C’s blood sugar and plasma level are stable!”

“Rat D’s blood sugar and plasma level have stabilized!”

…

12 hours passed.

“Rat A’s blood sugar and hormone levels are stable!”

“Rat B’s blood sugar and hormone levels are stable!”

“Rat D’s blood sugar and hormone levels are stable!”

…

24 hours passed.

“Rat A’s blood sugar and hormone levels are stable!”

“Rat B’s blood sugar and hormone levels are stable!”

“Rat C’s blood sugar and hormone levels are stable!”

“Rat D’s blood sugar and hormone levels are stable!”

…

The white mice were all specially fed and thus suffered from severe diabetes.

Under normal circumstances, not to mention 24 hours, even after five hours, the body’s hormones and blood sugar would definitely be abnormal.

Now, after 24 hours, everything was still normal!

This was enough to prove that… the human islet recovery medicine had a healing effect!

Academician Wang and Academician Li were stunned when they heard the results.

They had thought that… the human islet recovery medicine might have a certain effect.

However, they had never thought that the effect would be so obvious!

Seeing that the two of them were silent, Feng Yuxiang could not help but ask, “How is it?”

“It’s a success!” Academician Li said.

“Hahaha! Great! That’s great!” Feng Yuxiang said excitedly.

…

In Jiangbei City, there were green grass and trees by the lake. There was an open space of nearly 2,000 square meters.

The Liu family’s villa was located here.

Liu Sifang, who had a head full of flowery hair, was reading the Nature journal in his hand seriously with his presbyopic glasses.

After a long while, he sighed. “In the past, I always thought that my medical skills were not bad. In the end, let alone curing diabetes, I can’t understand even when I’m reading an article on the treatment of diabetes… I really have to admit that I’m old.”

Liu Yi, who was wearing gold-rimmed glasses, said, “This article is written using Western medicine terms. It’s not your fault.”

Liu Sifang shook his head noncommittally.

Liu Chuang, who had a full beard, said, “Old Master, what you meant just now was… The medicine for diabetes has been successfully developed?”

Liu Sifang said, “I consulted some people today. It should be… The name seems to be human islet recovery medicine.”

“I’m afraid that all the large pharmaceutical companies in the country and abroad will fight for this medicine,” Liu Chuang said.

“Yes, according to the information I received, Gray Rui, Qiang Da, Yunbei Baiyao, Sheng Sheng Tang, and many other top pharmaceutical companies have already prepared a large number of funds to get the sales rights in one go,” Liu Sifang said.

The entire hall fell into a short silence. All of them revealed a look of desire and helplessness.

At this moment, hurried footsteps sounded from outside.

“Dad, Grandpa, Uncle,” Liu Yuhang called out. “Do you know about the human islet recovery medicine?”

“Oh?” Liu Sifang could not help but laugh. “Since when did my Yuhang pay so much attention to medical news? Not bad, not bad!”

As he spoke, he picked up the teacup and prepared to take a few sips.

Liu Yuhang said, “This is the medicine that Brother Lin Fan invented. He said that he wants our family and the Sun family to sell it together.”

Pfft!

Liu Si spat out the tea in his mouth.

Then, he, Liu Chuang, and Liu Yi stood up from their seats. Their eyes were wide open, and their faces were filled with disbelief.

…

The Imperial Hotel, VIP room.

Liu Sifang, Liu Yi, Liu Chuang, Liu Yuhang, and the other core members of the Liu family, as well as Sun An, Sun Qingquan, Sun Luguo, and the other core members of the Sun family, were all gathered together.

They chatted with each other from time to time, and the atmosphere was extremely harmonious.

If there were other senior executives of pharmaceutical companies in Jiang Province present, they would definitely be so shocked that their jaws would drop to the ground after seeing this scene.

One had to know…

People of the same trade were enemies.

Liu Medical Company and Sun Medical Company were both first-class pharmaceutical companies in Jiang Province.

Due to this, the two families had always been like fire and water, constantly competing for the market.

It was already good enough that the Liu and Sun families did not fight. How could they ever have a meal together?
